notes: relative_path is resolved against DATA_ROOT (./data). Catalogue materials[].file is resolved against the dataset root (./data/samples), because that is how the catalogue declares it.
All five checksums and page counts below were measured from the supplied bytes with PyMuPDF and verified by scripts/validate_datasets.py.
Original PDFs are excluded from version control by .gitignore; presence and integrity are proven by this manifest.
Page counts sit inside the documented 9-17 page range, and every file carries an extractable text layer (see text_characters).

documents.title: Critical mass
documents.preflight_note: Born-digital, usable text layer. Logical visuals: figures on pages 1/5/9/10, tables on 6/9/11, displayed equations on page 7. Text-only extraction misses the displayed formulas, so equation recognition must be checked against page renders. Final page carries attribution and a CC BY-SA notice.
